response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position), shares AS (SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY attendance_count DESC) AS attendance_rank FROM counts) SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, share FROM shares WHERE attendance_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, member_id;
